name: Crisis Avert
source:
Although you are not a nerd, you are smarter than the people around you, just smarter. You live with your mother and Linda. Your father travels abroad frequently for his job, so your mother has to take care of you alone until you get a scholarship recently. You and your roommate Linda together have to leave your family for college. But when you go to college, you won't be very welcome.
Surely someone will help you with this. Surely... someone?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/scodarkhan]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
虽然你不是书呆子，但你比周围的人聪明，只是聪明而已。你和你的母亲和琳达住在一起。你的父亲因工作需要经常出国，所以你的母亲必须独自照顾你，直到你最近获得奖学金。你和你的室友琳达不得不离开家人去上大学。但当你上了大学，你就不会很受欢迎了。
肯定有人会帮助你解决这个问题。当然……有人吗？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/scodarkhan]Patreon[/url]]
